entries.name: ACI Concrete Strength Testing Technician
entries.definition: An American Concrete Institute certification for technicians who test the strength of concrete.

entries.name: Activity Director Certified
entries.definition: A certification for people who plan and run activity programs for residents of long-term care and similar facilities.

entries.name: Acute Care Nurse Practitioner
entries.definition: A nurse practitioner credential for providing advanced care to patients with acute, critical or complex illnesses.

entries.name: Adult Acute Care Nurse Practitioner
entries.definition: A nurse practitioner credential for caring for acutely ill adult patients.

entries.name: Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner
entries.definition: A nurse practitioner certification for caring for acutely ill adult and older-adult patients.

entries.name: Adult Nurse Practitioner
entries.definition: A nurse practitioner credential for providing primary care to adult patients.

entries.name: Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support
entries.definition: A course and certification in the emergency treatment of cardiac arrest and other life-threatening cardiovascular conditions, developed by the American Heart Association.

entries.name: Advanced Certified Fund Raising Executive
entries.definition: An advanced professional certification for senior fundraising executives.

entries.name: Advanced Certified Hospice and Palliative Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for advanced practice nurses in hospice and palliative care, awarded by the Hospice and Palliative Credentialing Center.

entries.name: Advanced Oncology Certified Clinical Nurse Specialist
entries.definition: A certification for clinical nurse specialists in oncology, awarded by the Oncology Nursing Certification Corporation.

entries.name: Advanced Oncology Certified Nurse Practitioner
entries.definition: A certification for nurse practitioners in oncology, awarded by the Oncology Nursing Certification Corporation.

entries.name: Advanced Trauma Life Support
entries.definition: A trauma-care training course and certification from the American College of Surgeons on the first assessment and management of injured patients.

entries.name: Aerial lift certification
entries.definition: A certificate showing that a person has been trained to operate aerial lifts such as boom lifts and scissor lifts.

entries.name: AIDS Certified Registered Nurse
entries.definition: A nursing certification for registered nurses who care for people with HIV and AIDS.

entries.name: Airline Transport Pilot certificate
entries.definition: The highest-level pilot certificate issued by the US Federal Aviation Administration, required for airline captains.

entries.name: All-terrain vehicle certification
entries.definition: A certificate showing completion of rider-safety training for operating all-terrain vehicles.

entries.name: American Board of Medical Laboratory Immunology certification
entries.definition: Certification by the American Board of Medical Laboratory Immunology in medical laboratory immunology.
variants: American Board Of Medical Laboratory Immunology (ABMLI) Certified

entries.name: American Board of Medical Microbiology certification
entries.definition: Certification by the American Board of Medical Microbiology in medical microbiology.
variants: American Board Of Medical Microbiology (ABMM) Certified

entries.name: American Board of Neurophysiologic Monitoring certification
entries.definition: Certification by the American Board of Neurophysiologic Monitoring in intraoperative neurophysiologic monitoring.

entries.name: American Board of Optometry certification
entries.definition: Board certification awarded by the American Board of Optometry to optometrists who show advanced knowledge and clinical skill.

entries.name: American Board of Pathology certification
entries.definition: Board certification awarded by the American Board of Pathology to pathologists in anatomic, clinical and other pathology specialties.

entries.name: American Culinary Federation certification
entries.definition: Professional certifications for cooks and chefs awarded by the American Culinary Federation, at several levels up to Certified Master Chef.

entries.name: American Medical Technologists certification
entries.definition: Certifications awarded by American Medical Technologists to allied health professionals such as medical technologists, medical assistants and phlebotomists.

entries.name: American Osteopathic Board of Nuclear Medicine certification
entries.definition: Board certification in nuclear medicine awarded by the American Osteopathic Board of Nuclear Medicine to osteopathic physicians.
variants: American Osteopathic Board Of Nuclear Medicine (AOBNM) Certified

entries.name: American Society of Pension Professionals and Actuaries certification
entries.definition: Retirement-plan credentials, such as the Qualified Pension Administrator and Qualified 401(k) Administrator, awarded by ASPPA, which is part of the American Retirement Association.
variants: American Society of Pension Professionals and Actuaries

entries.name: American Welding Society certification
entries.definition: Welding-related certifications awarded by the American Welding Society, such as Certified Welder and Certified Welding Inspector.

entries.name: Aquatic Facility Operator
entries.definition: A certification showing that someone is trained to operate and maintain a swimming pool or other aquatic facility, including water treatment and safety.

entries.name: ASCM certification
entries.definition: Supply-chain and operations-management certifications, such as CPIM and CSCP, awarded by the Association for Supply Chain Management, formerly APICS.
variants: American Production And Inventory Control Society (APICS) Certification

entries.name: ASQ certification
entries.definition: A professional certification awarded by the American Society for Quality, in fields such as quality engineering, auditing and Six Sigma.

entries.name: ASQ Certified Biomedical Auditor
entries.definition: A certification from ASQ for auditors who assess quality systems and regulatory compliance in the biomedical and medical-device industries.

entries.name: Assisted Housing Manager (AHM)
entries.definition: A professional certification for managers of assisted (government-subsidised) rental housing programmes.

entries.name: Associate degree in nursing
entries.definition: A two-year undergraduate nursing degree, usually awarded by community colleges, that prepares graduates to take the registered-nurse licensing exam.

entries.name: Associate of Applied Science in Accounting Technology
entries.definition: An applied associate degree, typically two years of study and awarded by a college, with a major in accounting technology.

entries.name: Associate of Applied Science in Aerospace Technology
entries.definition: An applied associate degree, typically two years of study and awarded by a college, with a major in aerospace technology.

entries.name: Associate of Applied Science in Animation and CGI Motion
entries.definition: An applied associate degree, typically two years of study and awarded by a college, with a major in animation and computer-generated (CGI) motion.
variants: AAS in Animation and CGI Motion

entries.name: Associate of Applied Science in Automotive Technology
entries.definition: An applied associate degree, typically two years of study and awarded by a college, with a major in automotive technology.

entries.name: Associate of Applied Science in Aviation Maintenance
entries.definition: An applied associate degree, typically two years of study and awarded by a college, with a major in aviation maintenance.

entries.name: Associate of Applied Science in Baking and Pastry Arts
entries.definition: An applied associate degree, typically two years of study and awarded by a college, with a major in baking and pastry arts.
variants: AAS in Baking and Pastry Arts

entries.name: Associate of Applied Science in Broadcasting Technology
entries.definition: An applied associate degree, typically two years of study and awarded by a college, with a major in broadcasting technology.

entries.name: Associate of Applied Science in Building Inspection Technology
entries.definition: An applied associate degree, typically two years of study and awarded by a college, with a major in building inspection technology.
